name: Lynn
review: 10/10!!!! This was a great stay for all my family and friends. We each had a relaxing place to sleep. We saw deer every day, near the lake and near the condo. We had separate space if you need quite time, with a ping pong tournament going on downstair on the lower level. We had a fire going every evening to relax by and talk about the great day we had riding on the trails system. We are looking forward to visiting and staying in this delightful home warming space again. Thanks again Lynn L.

name: Rachel
review: Michelle and Darryl were wonderful hosts and very responsive to questions and had wonderful recommendations for me and my kids. My kids loved the games in the basement. We had a lovely visit and highly recommend!

name: Denise
review:
We had an amazing trip . This condo is located close to town yet feels like you’re quietly tucked into your own private resort. It is spacious yet cozy . And the basement was a huge hit with basketball, ping pong and a cute bar area . The grandkids loved it too cool off and stay busy on a hot afternoon! 
Michelle was the best host! We had a small issue and she responded almost immediately and sent someone to take care of it ! Top line service! 
Highly recommended!!!

name: Stephen
review: Had a great stay.  Great location

name: Blaine
review: Beautiful house in an awesome location! Michelle and Darryl were extremely friendly!

name: Lindsey
review: We really enjoyed staying at Michelle & Darryl’s condo. The location was perfect and beautiful, and the home was very clean and cozy- perfect for our group. Would definitely stay again next time we are in Rangeley. We did have one issue (which turned out to be our fault), and they were very responsive, helpful and understanding, which was so appreciated!

name: Sarah
review: Our family reunion in Rangeley, Maine was all that I hoped for and more.  We stayed in Daryl and Michelles lovely “Treehouse”, a condo with three floors that had ample room for my family and me.  The two little boys ages 5 and 7 loved the little beach and the warm lake water, And especially jumping off the dock.   The last evening we all gathered around the firepit toasting marshmallows for s’mores, lighting endless sparklers, and talking and telling family stories.  The perfect weather added to it all as we picked out constellations in the night sky.  Would most definitely rent this charming and comfortable place again.

name: Katherine
review: What a lovely house in a great location! We really enjoyed our stay. The place is spacious and very nice for a large group. We were pleasantly surprised by how well-stocked the kitchen was, it had plenty of pots and pans to cook for 10. Basement is great for kids (or adults). Host is responsive and the instructions are very clear. We would gladly return.

name: Bryce
review: This house is a beautiful and comfortable place to getaway for a calm weekend with lots of fun if your interest in booking this property I would highly recommend it

name: Greg
review: Michelle and Darrell‘s place was absolutely perfect for our weekend ski trip to Saddleback Mountain. Comfortably accommodated our large family with plenty of room for adults and spacious bunkbeds for kids. Restaurants in town were only a very short drive and the mountain like they described is 15 minutes from the house, which makes it the perfect off mountain location.  Looking forward to booking again with them for our trip next year!

name: Teagan
review: A great spot in the heart of Rangeley! The townhouse layout with multiple floors was a great setup for our two families with kids for the weekend. Fully stocked kitchen, but also close to all the Rangeley restaurants!

name: Jared
review:
Great spot for a ski trip. A quick drive to Saddleback, and a fantastic setup in the house. The open living room and kitchen makes for a good social spot after a day of skiing. Plenty of board games provided, and the downstairs is full of games like ping pong, cornhole, etc!
Definitely will keep this spot in mind the next time we come up to ski Saddleback.
Thank you for having us!

name: Erika
review: Awesome place! Everything was as advertised. Plenty of space, bright with big windows and great views. Great location, 15 minutes to Saddleback and we drove to Sugarloaf one day. Cross country skiing was amazing! So close to downtown we walked to the shops. We enjoyed the great selection of games too. Will definitely be staying here again in winter and looking forward to checking out other seasons too!

name: Tanya
review: Great place and location. Would stay here again!
